name: bruno-victor-dev
description: Site bilíngue (PT/EN) e painel administrativo de Bruno Victor, desenvolvedor de software

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @bv/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @bv/api" "npm run dev -w @bv/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @bv/api && npm run build -w @bv/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @bv/api && npm run lint -w @bv/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
